notes: First-person text attributed to Albright, sent to the White House email list (blog post of September 20, 2016).

claim: Madeleine Albright's father was a diplomat and a strong supporter of democracy in Czechoslovakia.

notes: The email does not name the father.

claim: When the Communists took over, Madeleine Albright was forced into exile as a refugee.

evidence.quote: Email from Madeleine Albright
so when the Communists took over, we were forced into exile as refugees

notes: Supports the IHH line that the family fled Communist rule; no date for the exile given.

claim: In November 1948, Madeleine Albright was welcomed to the United States of America.

evidence.quote: Email from Madeleine Albright
In November 1948, we were welcomed to the United States of America.

notes: Gives the month of arrival (November 1948); the IHH page gives the year 1948 only.

claim: Madeleine Albright came here as a child, sailing into New York Harbor for the first time.

evidence.quote: Email from Madeleine Albright
When I came here as a child, I will never forget sailing into New York Harbor for the first time

notes: Contradicts the IHH page's place of immigration 'Denver, Colorado' as a port of entry: her own account names New York Harbor. Denver is not mentioned in this source. The same sentence spells 'Statute of Liberty' as written.
